picked.body: 공도에서 이륜차로 곡예 운전을 벌이고 있는 러시아 국적 30대 여성 관광객 N씨의 모습. (사진=칸화성 공안국) 베트남에서 오토바이로 위험천만한 곡예 운전을 벌인 외국인 관광객이 영구 추방됐다. 베트남 중남부 칸화성(Khanh Hoa) 공안국은 “지난 15일 깜란(Cam Ranh)국제공항 공안과 관계 기관들과의 협력을 통해 러시아 국적 30대 여성 N씨의 추방 절차를 마무리했다”고 21일 밝혔다. 공안 당국에 따르면 N씨는 공공질서 문란 혐의로 기소돼 지난 7월 지방인민법원에서 형법 제318조 제1항 공공질서 문란 혐의로 과태료 3,000만 동(1,153달러)과 영구 추방을 선고받은 것으로 전해졌다. 법원 판결문에 따르면, N씨는 작년 1월부터 6월 사이 휴양도시인 냐짱(Nha Trang) 인근 깜럼(Cam Lam) 및 남깜란(Nam Cam Ranh) 지역 공도에서 고배기량 오토바이를 무릎을 꿇은 채 운전해 교통법규를 위반했으며, 이를 촬영한 영상을 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에 반복적으로 업로드해 왔다. 칸화성 공안 당국은 “도로 이용자의 안전을 위협하고 공공질서는 해치는 교통법규 위반 행위는 내외국인을 가리지 않고, 관련 규정에 따라 엄중히 처벌될 것”이라며 주의를 당부했다. 외국인 관광객이 교통 관련 안전 규정 위반으로 베트남 현지 당국의 처벌을 받은 것은 이번이 처음은 아니다. 앞서 지난해 3월에는 한국 국적 관광객 2명이 다낭의 한 도로에서 고배기량 오토바이를 양손을 놓은 채 운전하다 공안 당국에 붙잡혀 과태료를 처분받기도 했다.

picked.t: Vietnam's newest carrier receives first Airbus widebody aircraft
picked.body: The aircraft arrived at Phu Quoc International Airport on Tuesday. It is the first of eight A330s the airline plans to receive between September and April 2027. With a range of up to 13,450 kilometers, the A330 will give the airline the capacity to develop more international routes. Sun PhuQuoc Airways plans to gradually connect Phu Quoc, Vietnam's largest island, to major markets with strong tourism potential, including Russia, Kazakhstan, Japan and Australia, and eventually destinations in Europe. The aircraft has 247 seats across three cabins: 20 business-class seats that recline 180 degrees into flat beds, 21 premium economy seats and 206 economy seats. All three cabins have personal entertainment screens and onboard Wi-Fi. After nearly a year of operations, Sun PhuQuoc Airways has 20 narrowbody A321 aircraft, including two A321 Long Range jets. The arrival of the widebody A330 expands its fleet and enhances the passenger experience on long international flights. With the addition of widebody aircraft, the airline expects its fleet to reach 33 planes by the end of 2026, 60 by the end of 2027 and 100 by the end of 2030. Sun PhuQuoc Airways launched its maiden flight in November last year. It is operated by Sun Group, one of Vietnam's largest developers of resorts and theme parks.

picked.t: Vietnam, US close to reaching reciprocal trade agreement
picked.body: Vietnam's Party General Secretary and President To Lam met the trade representative in New York on Monday morning as part of his trip to the U.S. to attend the High-Level General Debate of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly and conduct bilateral activities. The Vietnamese leader affirmed at the meeting that Vietnam attaches importance to its Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with the U.S. and wishes to work with President Donald Trump's administration to continue advancing bilateral relations in a stable, substantive, effective and sustainable manner. He stressed that economic, trade and investment cooperation is one of the most important pillars of bilateral relations, directly benefiting businesses and people and contributing to the development of both countries. In recent years, Vietnam has made efforts to substantively promote cooperation and purchase goods from the U.S. in order to boost bilateral trade in a more balanced direction, while creating more orders, jobs and direct benefits for businesses and workers in both countries, he continued. For his part, Greer highly appreciated the attention paid by the Vietnam leader and Vietnam's efforts to balance trade between the two countries. He also said that the two negotiating teams have made great efforts, and have so far made significant progress and come very close to reaching a final outcome. The trade representative said that once signed and implemented, the agreement on reciprocal, fair and balanced trade would continue to open up new opportunities and prospects for cooperation between the two countries. General Secretary and State President Lam welcomed the very positive results achieved by the two sides toward the early signing of the agreement, creating a stable, long-term framework for economic, trade and investment relations. He also called on the U.S. to take a comprehensive approach to outstanding trade issues, including those related to investigations under Section 301 of the U.S. Trade Act of 1974. On that basis, the leader expressed his wish that the two countries step up efforts to promote the substantive development of bilateral economic, trade and investment ties, thus bringing benefits to their people.

picked.t: Wait an hour for taxis: Heavy rain disrupts some tourists' plans as others enjoy cool air in HCMC
picked.body: Remy from Australia and his family of four stood outside a hotel on Bui Vien backpacker street on Wednesday afternoon, waiting nearly an hour but unable to find a ride-hailing taxi to a restaurant on Nguyen Hue Street nearly two kilometers away. "I've waited too long, and now we have to walk to a nearby restaurant for dinner," he said. "After dinner, we might just sip a beer at a nearby bar, since the rain hasn't stopped and the traffic jam could drag on." Initially, Remy had planned to take his children for ice cream on Nguyen Hue pedestrian street but scrapped the idea for fear that the heavy rain would continue into the night. According to the Southern Regional Hydro-Meteorological Center, rainfall in Ho Chi Minh City from Wednesday through 1 p.m. Friday is expected to total 70-100 mm, exceeding 150 mm in some areas. Widespread rain is forecast to continue into the evening of Sept. 23, following several heavy downpours since the start of the week. Emis from France and his friend stayed in their motel room for nearly two hours as Bui Vien Street and a nearby intersection were flooded to a depth of 20–30 centimeters along a stretch of about 400 meters. As the rain eased at nearly 4 p.m., they bought raincoats for VND20,000 each at a convenience store and took a walk to experience the city's rhythm on a rainy day. Though she knew it was the rainy season in the city, she was surprised that Vietnam's largest metropolis would experience heavy rain for a series of consecutive days, leaving downtown streets submerged and disrupting traffic. "Anyway, I really love Ho Chi Minh City. The weather these days is truly cool, a far cry from the sweltering heat back home," she added. As floodwaters began to recede, staff at bars on Bui Vien Street, one of Vietnam's busiest backpacker hubs, cleaned up their facilities in preparation for customers. Hung, who works at a bar there, said it took him more than half an hour to pump out the water and clear the floodwater in front. "I don't have much time. I have to finish before 5 p.m. so I can start welcoming guests—and hopefully, the rain stops," he added. Some foreign visitors even seem to enjoy the rainy weather while sipping beer. The rainy season in Ho Chi Minh City typically runs from May to November. The city welcomed an estimated 7.77 million international visitors in the first eight months of 2026, up 38.5% from the same period last year.

picked.t: 베트남, ‘요구불예금’ 4개 분기 연속 뒷걸음질…6월 말 기준 1,220조 동 전년동기比 10%↓
picked.body: 기사 이해를 돕기위해 AI를 활용해 제작한 이미지입니다. 베트남 은행권에 예치된 개인의 요구불예금이 4개 분기 연속 감소세를 보였다. 베트남중앙은행(SBV)의 최신 자료에 따르면, 6월 말 기준 개인의 요구불예금 잔액은 1,220조 동(468억8,250만여 달러)으로 잠정 집계됐다. 이는 전년 동기 대비 10% 가까이 감소한 수준으로, 4개 분기 연속 감소세다. 요구불예금은 개인이 은행을 통해 개설해 카드나 기타 비현금결제 수단으로 이용되는 자유로운 예금을 뜻한다. 일정 기간 자금을 예치해 이자를 받는 정기예금(저축성예금)과는 구분된다. 현재 규정상 베트남 은행권의 요구불예금 최대 이자율은 연 0.5%로 제한된다. 요구불예금 잔액은 분기별로 감소세를 거듭하고 있으나, 결제계좌 수는 분기마다 꾸준히 늘어 역대 최고치를 경신하고 있다. 6월 말 기준 은행권에 개설된 개인 결제계좌 수는 약 2억5,670만 개에 달했다. 2분기 말 기준 개인 결제계좌당 평균 잔액은 475만 동(182.5달러)을 기록했다. 요구불예금 잔액은 감소했으나, 은행권 전체 예금잔액은 지속적인 증가세를 보이고 있다. 6월 말 기준 요구불예금과 정기예금을 포함한 예금잔액은 올해 초와 비교해 7% 늘어 1경1,000조 동(4,227억1,130만 달러)을 넘어섰다. 올 들어 고금리 장기화에 가계예금은 꾸준히 증가하며 사상 최고치를 연이어 경신하고 있다. 실제 베트남의 여러 시중은행이 예금고객 유치를 위해 수천만 동에서 수억 동에 달하는 예금에 연 9%에 가까운 금리를 제공하고 있는데, 이는 공시금리보다 2~3%포인트 높은 수준이다. 이 밖에도 테크콤은행(Techcombank)와 베트남국제은행(VIB), VP은행(VPBank) 등은 결졔계좌 유휴자금을 유치하기 위해 최대 연 5~6% 수익률을 보장하는 ‘수익형계좌’ 상품을 내놓고 고객 모시기에 열을 올리고 있다. 일부 상품은 계좌 내 일정 기준을 초과한 자금을 수익형계좌 또는 연계 투자상품으로 자동 이체하면서도, 고객이 필요할 때 언제든 인출할 수 있도록 설계돼 눈길을 끌고 있다.
